text:
Oh my gollie!
These babies!!! 🥰
Oh-so-funny yet still oh-so-pogi 🤩

Baekhyuniee being competitive at the same time being goofy. 🤪 A true entertainer! Him being himself from then till now. The evidence are their previous years' videos from EXO-ladder and Showtime.

Chanyeol, the ever competitive man on earth at the same time being the best in everything he focused on to do. It's very evident guys, the way he pronounce and enunciate every syllables perfectly and furiously. That's my bias wrecker ladies and gents. 😉 But why do you always end up on the floor when you laugh Loey love? Minsan gusto ko na talagang maging si Mareng Floor. 😅 Oh my happy virus Yeol! 😁

Sehunie, our baby bird, 🐦 is so cute being so focused yet can't contain his laughter.  Even our maknae is so competitive now 'coz remember the last EXO-Arcade guys? How his Suho-hyung comfort him after few times that they are not winning the games? But our Sehunie became more mature now. And most of the time that the camera's focus was him, he is laughing.

Meanwhile, Kai, who's most of the time the loser in every game that the group had played, is the ace of the game now. Who will ever forget his iconic whisper challenge in EXO-Arcade and Knowing Bros? 😂 Our baby bear became so focused and competitive now like his Chanyeol-hyung. 🐻 I think he even scolded D.O. for making mistakes. 😂But what's with the orange hair Nini? 🧡

The ever young-looking Xiumin-hyung is also trying his best but seems like his the X-man in Khyunie's team. 😅😂 Our aegyo 👶 Minseokie is so tensed while playing, you can almost see all of his teeth while talking during the game. 😬 Relax Minmin!

And last but definitely not the least amongst these entertainers who made my day even if I just woke up, my bias, D.O. loves. That boxy heart smile, adorbs! 😍 Forget about his mistakes cause it was all melted away by his smiles. We definitely missed our penguin. 🐧
Kyungsoo focusing and even practicing the words before his turn, but then again failed. 🤦‍♀️ But the pressure and determination made their team win. 🎉 See how sweet and thoughtful this guy? He even offered a drink to the MC. From then till now Kyungsoo-yah, definitely my kind of man! 🥰

EXO Saranghaja! 🤗😘❤
